landing.title: Paste the Job Description. Get the profiles you need.
landing.subtitle: AI-Hunting reads the JD, finds public LinkedIn profiles that fit and hands them to you ranked by match, with the outreach message ready.
landing.step1Body: Text, PDF, Word or a screenshot. AI extracts seniority, skills and location.
landing.step2Body: We track down matching public profiles and drop duplicates.
landing.step3Body: 20 to 30 profiles with a match score, reasons and a personalized message.
landing.footnote: AI-Hunting never logs into your LinkedIn account or sends messages on your behalf.
